application_method: This is a SEPARATE scholarship application, submitted immediately after the undergraduate admission application. NTU states: "If you wish to be considered for a scholarship, you should submit your online scholarship application immediately after you've completed your admission application. The scholarship application deadline is the same as the admission deadline."
First complete the NTU undergraduate admission application through the official Applicant Portal.

Then click the "Apply for Scholarship" link at the end of the online admission application, log in with your application number, select the scholarship types you want, list your top 3 achievements, and submit a Personal Essay of not more than 250 words on the one compulsory topic provided.
After submitting, upload a passport-sized photograph and send the referee URL to your referee; the referee has 7 days to submit the online appraisal.
The referee must be a school teacher or a person who is familiar with the applicant, but must not be the applicant's family member or relative.
If shortlisted, attend a selection interview in person.
Accept the NTU offer and the scholarship offer by the stipulated deadline; the scholarship outcome is usually notified within 2 to 3 weeks after the interview.
new_scholarship.description: The ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship is a freshmen scholarship awarded by Nanyang Technological University to Singapore Permanent Residents or citizens of ASEAN countries other than Singapore who are entering a full-time undergraduate degree programme leading to a first degree, excluding the Renaissance Engineering Programme. It covers the full subsidised tuition fee after the MOE Tuition Grant, and provides a living allowance of S$5,800 per academic year, an accommodation allowance of S$3,000 per academic year and a one-off computer allowance of S$1,750. Tenability runs for the normal programme duration conditional on good academic performance and exemplary conduct. No scholarship bond is attached; the only service obligation is the three-year MOE Tuition Grant bond applicable to all Singapore Permanent Residents and international students.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Outstanding Singapore Permanent Residents or citizens of an ASEAN member state other than Singapore who hold strong Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level, Singapore polytechnic diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent results, with an excellent co-curricular record and demonstrated leadership, who are entering a full-time NTU first-degree programme other than the Renaissance Engineering Programme and who can accept the three-year MOE Tuition Grant bond.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to Singapore Permanent Residents or citizens of ASEAN countries other than Singapore who are applying for admission to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU leading to a first degree, excluding the Renaissance Engineering Programme. Applicants must have outstanding academic achievements shown by strong Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, Diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, NUS High School Diploma, International Baccalaureate Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications, an excellent co-curricular record, and strong leadership qualities and potential. The award covers up to the normal programme duration conditional on good academic performance and exemplary conduct, and recipients must take up the MOE Tuition Grant and serve the three-year MOE Tuition Grant bond. There is no separate scholarship bond.

new_scholarship.selection_notes: Selection is by separate scholarship application followed by shortlisting. NTU states that applicants "are allowed to apply for more than one scholarship" and that the university reviews each application against all available scholarships and awards within the selected scholarship types. Only shortlisted applicants are informed via email. For applicants applying on the basis of Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, Diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, NUS High School Diploma or the IB Diploma, interviews are conducted between March and May and only shortlisted applicants are informed via email before end-May. For applicants applying on the basis of a Year 12 equivalent qualification, interviews are conducted within 2 months from the date the NTU programme offer is released, and applicants shortlisted for the interview are informed via email within a month from the date of the NTU programme offer. NTU states it will usually inform applicants of the outcome within 2 to 3 weeks after the interview and that the scholarship offer must be accepted by the stipulated deadline. NTU publishes no numerical weighting between academic results, co-curricular record, leadership and interview performance.
new_scholarship.notes: Award amounts: the single figure recorded in funding_amount is the S$5,800 per academic year living allowance, which is the only recurring cash NTU states as a fixed sum for this award. The accommodation allowance of S$3,000 per academic year and the one-off computer allowance of S$1,750 are additional and are itemised in benefits; over a three-year programme the non-tuition cash total is S$17,400 living allowance plus S$9,000 accommodation allowance plus S$1,750 computer allowance, i.e. S$28,150. Tuition coverage is stated only against the subsidised tuition fee payable after the MOE Tuition Grant; NTU publishes the AY2026/27 subsidised tuition fee for ASEAN international students separately on its tuition fees page and the exact figure per programme band was not resolved unambiguously from the fetched table, so no tuition amount is recorded in funding_amount. fully_funded is false because the award carries the three-year MOE Tuition Grant bond, which is a service obligation, even though tuition is fully covered at the subsidised rate. NTU states there is no bond attached to this scholarship apart from the three-year bond applicable to all Singapore Permanent Residents and international students under the MOE Tuition Grant Scheme. deadline_date is null because NTU publishes several different exact calendar deadlines, one per admission qualification route, rather than a single date for the scholarship; deadline_precision is therefore "varies" and every published date is reproduced in the deadline and application_period fields. English_requirement is null because NTU publishes no English language test or score requirement on this scholarship page; the scholarship application process page publishes no document checklist beyond the digital application, the essay, the photograph and the referee appraisal. NTU publishes no numerical selection weighting. The distinct NTU Nanyang Global Scholarship (NGS) and the NTU University Engineering Scholarship (UES) are separate awards in the same catalogue and are not merged into this record.

programme_detail_official.deadline_note: NTU publishes no single scholarship deadline for the ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship. Its own words are "The application period for this scholarship is the same as the admission application period", and the scholarship application deadline is the same as the admission deadline. The official Important Dates page therefore publishes a different exact calendar date for each admission qualification route: Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' Levels, day of A-Level results release to 19 March 2027, with the scholarship online application due by 19 March 2027; Diploma awarded by a Polytechnic or equivalent institution in Singapore, 1 to 21 February 2027, with the scholarship online application due by 21 February 2027; NUS High School Diploma, 1 December 2026 to 20 January 2027, with the scholarship online application due by 20 January 2027; International Baccalaureate, 15 October 2026 to 19 March 2027, with the scholarship online application due by 19 March 2027. For Year 12 equivalent qualifications the published application period closes on the qualification-specific date, ranging from 20 January 2027 (for example Indonesian Ijazah SMA, Malaysia UEC, Philippines G12 Senior High School Diploma, Thailand Mathayom 6, Vietnam High School Graduation Certificate, Myanmar Matriculation Exam, South Korean CSAT, Taiwan GSAT, Canada Ontario SSD/BC High School) to 19 March 2027 (for example Brunei GCE A-Level, Malaysia STPM, Mauritius HSC, India Standard 12, Sri Lanka A-Level, PRC Gao Kao, UK A-Level/Cambridge Pre-U, HKDSE, French/Spanish/European Baccalaureate, American High School Diploma with AP). Because the date varies by qualification route, deadline_central and deadline_date are null and deadline_precision is "varies". One week after each scholarship application deadline, NTU also requires submission of the photograph and appraisal form: 27 January 2027 (NUS High School Diploma route), 28 February 2027 (Singapore polytechnic diploma route) and 26 March 2027 (GCE A-Level and IB routes).
programme_detail_official.status_note: The award page is live and published, the award is not marked discontinued, and the AY2027 intake cycle is published on the official Important Dates page with application windows opening from 15 October 2026 for international and other qualifications and the IB Diploma, 1 December 2026 for the NUS High School Diploma, and day of A-Level results release 2027 for the Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' Levels, closing between 20 January 2027 and 19 March 2027. As at 2026-10-03 the listing carries no closed notice, no pause notice and no waitlist notice, so the cycle is treated as OPEN for the coming intake, with the earliest window opening 15 October 2026. Timezone Asia/Singapore is inferred from the awarding university's location and is not stated as a clock time on the page; NTU publishes deadlines as dates only.

programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: NTU states the scholarship covers the full subsidised tuition fees, payable after the MOE Tuition Grant. fully_funded is recorded as false for two reasons stated in the official text. First, NTU states that no bond is attached to this scholarship apart from the three-year bond applicable to all Singapore Permanent Residents and international students under the MOE Tuition Grant Scheme, and NTU's Tuition fees and grants page states that "Permanent Residents and international students who accept the MOE tuition grant are required to sign the Tuition Grant Agreement, which obliges you to work for a Singapore entity for three (3) years upon graduation"; that is a service obligation attaching to any recipient of this award. Second, tuition coverage is stated only against the subsidised tuition fee payable after the MOE Tuition Grant, not against the full non-subsidised tuition fee, so the gap between the subsidised and non-subsidised rates is not covered. NTU also states that the compulsory miscellaneous fees are payable in addition to the tuition fee.

Recipients must take up the MOE Tuition Grant, and as Singapore Permanent Residents or international students they are required to sign the Tuition Grant Agreement, which contractually obliges them to work in a Singapore entity for three (3) years upon graduation
The MOE Tuition Grant bond runs concurrently with any other bond obligation and is administered by the Ministry of Education, separately from NTU's own scholarship bond administration

The MOE Tuition Grant registration and signing must be completed by the stipulated deadline; students who do not apply for the Tuition Grant or do not complete the registration and signing requirements are liable for the full non-subsidised tuition fees, and late applications are not considered under any circumstances

Two sureties of any nationality are required for the MOE Tuition Grant Agreement, aged 21 and above but below 65, who must not be undischarged bankrupts and must not be tuition grant or scholarship applicants or recipients with outstanding tuition grant obligations
Compulsory miscellaneous fees remain payable in addition to the tuition fee covered by the scholarship and the Tuition Grant

It covers the full subsidised tuition fees payable after the MOE Tuition Grant, and provides a living allowance of S$5,800 per academic year, an accommodation allowance of S$3,000 per academic year and a one-off computer allowance of S$1,750. application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are a Singapore Permanent Resident or a citizen of an ASEAN member state other than Singapore, because Singapore citizens and citizens of non-ASEAN countries are both excluded
Confirm your intended programme is not the Renaissance Engineering Programme, which is expressly excluded from this award
Complete the NTU undergraduate admission application first, because the scholarship application is submitted immediately after it and cannot precede it
Identify the exact application deadline for your own qualification route from the official Important Dates page, not a single generic date, because the deadline differs by qualification
Prepare the Personal Essay of not more than 250 words on the compulsory topic before you open the scholarship application, because the essay is submitted inside the same online form
Line up your referee in advance and brief them, because you must send them the referee URL and they have only 7 days to complete the online appraisal
Make sure your referee is a school teacher or someone who knows you, and is not a family member or relative
Have a passport-sized photograph ready to upload immediately after the scholarship application is submitted

Be available between March and May if you are applying on the GCE A-Level, Singapore polytechnic diploma, NUS High School Diploma or IB Diploma route, because that is when NTU states the interviews are conducted
Be available within two months of your NTU programme offer if you are applying on a Year 12 equivalent qualification route
Decide before you apply whether you accept the three-year MOE Tuition Grant bond to work in a Singapore entity after graduation, because taking the grant is a condition of the tuition coverage
Identify two potential sureties who meet the MOE Tuition Grant criteria, because the Tuition Grant Agreement requires two sureties aged 21 to 64 who are not undischarged bankrupts
common_rejection_risks: Missing the qualification-specific deadline, for example assuming the 19 March 2027 GCE A-Level and IB deadline also applies when you hold the NUS High School Diploma, whose scholarship deadline is 20 January 2027, or a Singapore polytechnic diploma, whose deadline is 21 February 2027
Applying to the Renaissance Engineering Programme, which is expressly excluded
Being a Singapore citizen, or holding a nationality outside ASEAN, either of which makes you ineligible
Attempting to submit the scholarship application before or instead of the undergraduate admission application, since NTU states the scholarship application follows the admission application
The referee missing the 7-day window for the online appraisal, or nominating a family member or relative as referee
Being slow to submit the passport-sized photograph and appraisal form, which have their own deadline one week after the scholarship application deadline

Not holding the grant: students who do not apply for the Tuition Grant or fail to complete registration and signing by the stipulated deadline are liable for the full non-subsidised tuition fees and late applications are not considered
Falling below good academic performance or exemplary conduct during the programme, because tenure is conditional on both
Confusing this award with the NTU Nanyang Global Scholarship or the NTU University Engineering Scholarship, which are separate awards with different benefits and bonds
estimated_uncovered_costs: The difference between the subsidised tuition fee payable after the MOE Tuition Grant and the full non-subsidised tuition fee, because coverage is stated only against the subsidised fee
The compulsory miscellaneous fees, which NTU states are payable in addition to tuition and are not covered by the scholarship
Living expenses beyond the S$5,800 annual living allowance
Accommodation costs above the S$3,000 annual accommodation allowance, including the difference between higher-rated on-campus room types and the allowance amount
Travel and passage costs between the applicant's home country and Singapore, because this award carries no travel or passage allowance
Settling-in costs on arrival in Singapore, because this award carries no settling-in allowance
Student pass, visa and immigration-related costs

alerts.message: NTU states "The application period for this scholarship is the same as the admission application period." There is no single closing date. For the AY2027 cycle the scholarship application deadline is 19 March 2027 on the GCE A-Level and IB Diploma routes, 21 February 2027 on the Singapore polytechnic diploma route and 20 January 2027 on the NUS High School Diploma route, and Year 12 equivalent qualifications close on dates between 20 January 2027 and 19 March 2027. Check the Important Dates page for your own qualification.

This is not automatic on admission. NTU instructs applicants to "submit your online scholarship application immediately after you've completed your admission application", through the Apply for Scholarship link at the end of the online admission application. If you do not submit it, you will not be considered.

NTU states no bond is attached to this scholarship apart from the three-year bond applicable to all Singapore Permanent Residents and international students under the MOE Tuition Grant Scheme, which contractually obliges work in a Singapore entity for three years upon graduation. Two sureties are required, and registration and signing must be completed by the stipulated deadline or you become liable for the full non-subsidised tuition fees.

The award is for full-time undergraduate degree programmes leading to a first degree, "other than the Renaissance Engineering Programme (REP)". If REP is your intended programme, this scholarship does not apply to you.

For the GCE A-Level, Singapore polytechnic diploma, NUS High School Diploma and IB Diploma routes, interviews are between March and May and only shortlisted applicants are informed by email before end-May. For Year 12 equivalent qualifications, interviews are within 2 months from the date the NTU programme offer is released, and shortlisted applicants are informed within a month from the date of that offer. Keep your email monitored.
NTU's scholarship application process states the interview step is an "Interview (In person)". Factor travel and availability into your plans if you are shortlisted from outside Singapore.

Tuition coverage is stated only against the subsidised tuition fee payable after the MOE Tuition Grant, not the full non-subsidised fee, and the compulsory miscellaneous fees remain payable in addition.

Check your email regularly; only shortlisted applicants are contacted

Accept the admission offer with the MOE Tuition Grant, then register and sign the Tuition Grant Agreement on MOE's TG&S portal in September of your admitted year with two qualifying sureties

research_notes.logo: Followed the PART D logo hunt order. The awarding body is NTU itself, so the correct mark is the NTU institutional logo, not a ministry or agency mark. Step 1: I inspected the site header markup of the ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship detail page and the other official ntu.edu.sg admissions pages, and every page renders the institution's own mark as an img with src /ResourcePackages/NTU/assets/images/NTU_Logo.png and alt text "Nanyang Technological University", which confirmed the asset family before fetching any bytes. I probed that asset live on 2026-10-03: HEAD returned HTTP 200 with Content-Type image/png, and a GET downloaded 357,899 bytes with a valid PNG signature (89-50-4E-47) and 32-bit ARGB colour, 3006x1079 px. I then downloaded the file and ran a sampled pixel probe to satisfy PART D rule 6: about 27% of sampled pixels are opaque and dark, and the remainder are largely transparent, so this is a dark-on-transparent institutional wordmark and is visible on a light card rather than an excluded white-on-transparent wordmark. Rule 7 was applied during probing: I did not accept any HTML response as validation, and every acceptance was an image content type with PNG magic bytes. I also tried two alternates on the same host before settling: /favicon.ico returned HTTP 200 as image/x-icon, 2,425 bytes, which is the browser tab mark rather than the institutional wordmark, so it was not used, and /apple-touch-icon.png returned HTTP 404 and was discarded. The chosen URL is served by www.ntu.edu.sg, the same registrable domain as ntu.edu.sg, so host_evidence is same_registrable_domain and official_host is true. Note for the merge step: if backend/config/official_logo_overrides.json already carries an ntu.edu.sg key, that entry will be deduped at merge time and this entry should not create a second key.

NTU's scholarship catalogue classifies the award as scholarship type University-Level, student type Freshmen, and the detail page's eligibility criterion is "applying for admission to full time undergraduate degree programme leading to a first degree, other than the Renaissance Engineering Programme (REP)". The academic qualifications NTU accepts, namely the Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, the Diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, the NUS High School Diploma, the International Baccalaureate Diploma and Year 12 equivalent qualifications, are all first-degree entry qualifications, and NTU's Important Dates page places the application windows inside the undergraduate admissions cycle.
